independent_sampling_execution_contract.reviewer_minimum_independence: The reviewer did not author, translate, render or validate the submitted Chinese or English materials and declares any conflict of interest.

paired key figures and their captions/legends/warnings

review_order: record exact head and artifact hashes before reading
review HUMAN-EQ-01 through HUMAN-EQ-08 without consulting contributor conclusions
record pass, discrepancy or cannot-determine for every sample
classify every discrepancy by claim effect rather than wording preference
correct all material discrepancies across every affected surface
refresh manifest and rerun exact-head checks before signoff
sign only the corrected exact head
independent_sampling_execution_contract.material_discrepancy_definition: Any difference that changes the core ruling, prototype identity, operating-state effect, number/unit/denominator, evidence authority, G0/approval boundary, public right, professional veto, figure meaning or implementation gate.
independent_sampling_execution_contract.fail_closed_rule: A missing sample result, cannot-determine result or unresolved material discrepancy prevents independent-human equivalence signoff; deterministic bilingual PASS remains only a packaging result.

exact_head_record.artifact_hash_authority: manifest.json Git blob SHA-256 records at the final PR exact head
exact_head_record.recording_rule: Do not prefill the head or hashes before the final commit. The independent reviewer records them before reading and signs only that exact head.

contributor_precheck_results.evidence: BME-01 through BME-18 and EQ-01 through EQ-11 record contributor-side structural, claim, number, status, position, human-task, media-accessibility, duty-acceptance and bounded-policy comparisons.
contributor_precheck_results.limit: This precheck helps a human reviewer sample efficiently but cannot populate human_result, reviewer identity, independence or signoff fields.

formal_human_review_packet.signoff_rule: Do not change the independent-human status until a real reviewer completes every sample, records discrepancies and signs the result.

open_boundary.effect: This record supports contributor-side editorial QA only. It must not be presented as independent human confirmation or certified translation.

non_certification: This is a contributor-side editorial equivalence record produced by the submission agent. It is not independent human confirmation, certified translation, public feedback, professional approval, field evidence or an independent rights audit. Exact-head deterministic and visual QA verifies artifact consistency but cannot certify translation quality.
